checklist.request:
Can an additive intervention at the country token promote the later
Berlin answer while preserving Japan-related information?

completion.what_was_done: Answered: within this bounded search, no such edit was found. 69 candidates were screened alone and in within-layer top-3 / top-5 groups at beta 0.5, 1 and 2 on the tuning prompt (256 settings). The largest rise of logit(Berlin) - logit(Tokyo) is +0.314 against the +1.0 required; 250 of 256 settings preserve Japan-related information by the three tolerances. The preservation-passing setting with that largest effect was frozen and run once on both reserved prompts with three matched random controls: +0.381 and +0.293 logits (random controls at most +0.201), with the " is" tolerance failing there (fall 0.095). The pilot does not pass.
completion.evidence: REPORT.md section "Addendum: can an additive edit promote Berlin while preserving Japan?", paragraphs "Result on the tuning prompt", "Result on the reserved prompts" and "Conclusion", Figure 4; RESULTS.md Section 5 ("Outcome"), Sections 5.5 and 5.7, Figures 4, 6 and 7; results/additive/tuning_summary.json and pilot_verdict.json.
